name: Strasbourg car park occupancy (Eurometropole)
short: Live free spaces in Strasbourg car parks. Free, no key, Licence Ouverte.
summary: The Eurometropole de Strasbourg open data portal serves a keyless Opendatasoft API with real-time car park occupancy: name, state, total and free places, a user-facing count, occupancy rate, a green-to-red status colour and coordinates. On 2026-11-08 the dataset held 35 car parks (for example Parking Gare Wodli, 633 of 955 free); the dataset was processed minutes before the call.

tasks: free places in a Strasbourg car park now
occupancy rate of Strasbourg car parks
whether a Strasbourg car park is open

coverage.notes: 35 car parks on 2026-11-08, including railway-station and park-and-ride sites.

delivery.basis: Live GET 2026-11-08: dataset data_processed time was minutes old.
